title: Continuity of the tangent projection field of one bi-Lipschitz piece on its image
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, C ⊆ ℝⁿ, F: ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} and c ∈ ℝ with c > 0 and c|v − w| ≤ |F(v) − F(w)| for all v, w ∈ C. Suppose DF(w) = fderiv ℝ F w is injective for every w ∈ C and w ↦ DF(w) is continuous on C. Then there is G: ℝ^{n+ℓ} → L(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ^{n+ℓ}) that is continuous on F(C) and satisfies G(F(w)) = orthogonal projection onto DF(w)(ℝⁿ) for every w ∈ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ v ∈ C, ∀ w ∈ C, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F v - F w‖) → (∀ w ∈ C, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F w)) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) C → ∃ G : Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), ContinuousOn G (F '' C) ∧ ∀ w ∈ C, G (F w) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F w).toLinearMap).starProjection
